name: QuestBench
description: QuestBench evaluates whether LLMs can identify the right clarification question to ask when faced with underspecified reasoning problems. It tests information-acquisition ability by presenting tasks missing one key piece of information and asking models to select the correct clarification question from multiple choices, across logic, planning, and math domains.
reputation: Accepted at NeurIPS 2025 Datasets and Benchmarks track; from Google DeepMind
notes: 4 subsets: Logic-Q (~1K), Planning-Q (~7.5K), GSM-Q, GSME-Q; SOTA models achieve only 40-50% on Logic-Q and Planning-Q despite solving fully specified versions well; focuses on single clarification question scenarios.
